title: Netherlands – Eye care products and corrective lenses – EA Brillen - 2026
description: Het Ministerie van Defensie (hierna: de Aanbestedende dienst) verstrekt op basis van oogmetingen die uitgevoerd worden in het Centraal Medisch Hospitaal (CMH), het Dienstencentrum Personeelslogistiek (DCPL) en in het Centrum voor Mens en Luchtvaart (CML) aan alle brildragende militairen een Dienstbril, een Inzetbril voor de ballistische bril (scherfwerende bril) en een Inzetbril voor het veldmasker (CBRN-masker). Luchtvaartpersoneel krijgt daarnaast ook een Vliegerbril verstrekt die gedragen wordt tijdens de uitvoering van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en medewerkers van de Defensie brandweer krijgen een Inzetbril voor in het brandweermasker verstrekt. De brildragende militair gebruikt de Bril(len) (dagelijks) op zijn werkplek, voor oefenen en trainen, maar ook bij inzet onder de zwaarste omstandigheden waaronder missies. Als militair oefent men vaak en werkt men aan de fysieke conditie, zodat men skills en drills beheerst als het er echt op aankomt. Uiteenlopende sportactiviteiten (contactsporten uitgezonderd) worden beoefend. Er wordt getraind op de hindernisbanen en onder alle omstandigheden in ruig terrein. Naast trainen oefent men, zo’n oefening duurt soms een paar uur, maar dat kan ook meerdere weken zijn. Oefenen kan in Nederland op de hei zijn waar de Brillen blootgesteld worden aan zand en stof, maar dit kan ook het buitenland zijn bijvoorbeeld bij koudweertraining in Noorwegen (polair gebied), of een jungletraining in Suriname (tropische omstandigheden). De Brillen dienen daarom geschikt te zijn voor gebruik tijdens deze (fysiek) zware omstandigheden en moeten hierbij goed op het hoofd blijven zitten. description: The Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Norwegian and Swedish Embassy in Berlin (the contracting authority) are looking for a supplier to provide cleaning services. The Nordic Embassies were opened in their current form in 1999. They operate under the leadership of the respective ambassadors of the participating countries and form an important part of Berlin’s diplomatic landscape. The Nordic Embassies complex, consisting of five individual embassy buildings and the shared “Felleshus” building, symbolizes the close cooperation among the Nordic states while preserving their respective national identities. The Felleshus serves as a public venue and platform for cultural and scientific exchange projects that strengthen dialogue between the Nordic countries and Germany. The Nordic Embassies are guided by the principle of sustainability and are committed to promoting innovation and environmentally friendly projects. The cleaning services shall be delivered in the Danish, Icelandic, Norwegian and Swedish building and the Felleshus. The buildings cover a total area of approximately 3,285 m² and 2,400 m² of underground parking space. Finland is only part of the procurement because of the Felleshus and cleaning of the Finnish Embassy is not part of the Contract. The Contract concerns delivery of regular cleaning, deep cleaning, internal glass cleaning, special cleaning and ad-hoc cleaning. It is a requirement that the certain key tasks, regular cleaning and deep cleaning, cf. annex 1.2, are performed by the successful tenderer itself. The contracting authority will hold an information meeting and an inspection of the place of performance for potential tenderers. For more information see the tender conditions section 3.4 (Information meeting and Inspection).

Delkontrakternes maksimale omsætning (værdi) er estimeret til at være +20% pr. delkontrakt. Tildeling af konkrete opgaver under rammeaftalen sker efter en kaskademodel, hvorefter leverandørerne anvendes i følgende prioriterede rækkefølge pr. delkontrakt: • Leverandør 1 • Leverandør 2 • Leverandør 3 Ordregiver skal ved hver konkret opgave først rette henvendelse til Leverandør 1. Såfremt Leverandør 1 ikke kan påtage sig opgaven, herunder som følge af kapacitetsmæssige forhold, er Ordregiver berettiget til at tildele opgaven til Leverandør 2. description: This announcement is to all Small Business, 8(a) Small Business, HUBZone Small Business, Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and Women-Owned Small Business concerns that may be interested in performing a contract for the California Great Basin Region of the Bureau of Reclamation. The work to be performed is described below. Based upon response to this announcement, the Government may determine to set this acquisition aside or proceed with an unrestricted solicitation. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 541620 and the related small business size standard is $19M. This notice is not a request for proposal and the information presented in this announcement will not obligate the Bureau of Reclamation in any manner. The estimated cost of this project is $1,000,000.00-$5,000,000.00. This sources sought notice is for market research and acquisition planning purposes only. No formal solicitation for this work exists at this time. The work is located in Redding and Sacramento, California. Interested parties should include the following information in their response: (a) Business name, address, cage code, size classification based on NAICS size standard, socioeconomic classification (i.e. HUBZone; 8(a), etc.), and a point of contact; (b) A positive statement of your intention to submit an offer for this solicitation as a prime contractor; (c) Evidence of your experience performing work similar in type and scope to the work in this announcement within the last five years. The evidence should include: contract numbers, project titles, dollar amounts and points of contacts with telephone numbers. Please do not include more than three past projects; and (d) Include attachments cataloging the company's equipment assets, personnel resources and financial resources that demonstrate company responsibility and capability to perform required work. (e) If bonding is required, also provide evidence of your bonding capacity; All interested parties are encouraged to respond to this notice, by e-mail to Marianna_mezentseva@ios.doi.gov not later than 5PM PDT on October 05, 2026. The information provided in this announcement is all information the Government has available at this time. There are no specifications, drawings, bid packages, or source lists available. System for Award Management (SAM) applies to this procurement. Prospective contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) prior to award. Lack of registration in the SAM database will make an offeror ineligible for award. Information on SAM registration can be obtained via the Internet at http://www.sam.gov PRINCIPAL COMPONENTS OF WORK: The scope of this contract is to provide comprehensive professional services to support Reclamation in fulfilling its legal and regulatory obligations under the NEPA, ESA, and National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA), and other environmental laws for the Shasta Dam and Reservoir Enlargement Project (SDREP). Professional services will include project management, technical document development including biological, cultural resources, and environmental analyses, as well as administrative, logistical, and technical support. These services will assist Reclamation in fulfilling its mission to ensure continued management and delivery of water and related resources in a manner that ensures timely, legally defensible deliverables in support of compliance with applicable federal, state, and local environmental laws, regulations, and policies.
